versions.content: Service Name Bmc_FetchAdd_u Syntax Bmc_AtomicUType Bmc_FetchAdd_u ( volatile Bmc_AtomicUType * Object, Bmc_AtomicUType Operand ) Service ID [hex] 0x50 to 0x53 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) Operand Value for the operation Parameters (inout) Object Object Parameters (out) None Return value Bmc_AtomicUType The value pointed to by Object immediately before the effects Description Atomically replaces the value pointed to by Object with the result of the addition applied to the value pointed to by Object and the given Operand. Available via Bmc.h
